text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's debut race comes to a close, and it seems like her friend remains far off in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We still don't know how to bridge that distance. For now, we can only press on while I try to deepen my understanding of Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To close the huge gap standing between us and her friend, we decide to take a slower approach by focusing on training and racing.
